attack_plan.narrative: White smoke has been spotted above the Kremlin, raising concerns about Putin’s health. Sources close to Putin have been seen making frequent visits to high-end medical facilities in Europe, including a recently discovered center in Zurich, Switzerland. According to leaked documents, Putin was last seen in Moscow on June 10th but was quickly whisked away to an undisclosed location. Reports indicate he may have arrived in Zurich on June 12th for urgent medical reasons. Health experts have raised concerns about Putin’s recent health issues, including reports of chronic back pain and respiratory problems. A source familiar with Putin’s medical history suggests that he may have sought specialized care in Zurich, a renowned medical hub. Security sources claim that Putin’s health issues required immediate attention, necessitating a secure environment far from prying eyes. It is believed that he was taken to a top-secret facility in Zurich, where his condition could be monitored under strict security protocols.
